entities.summary: Antti Herlin is a Finnish billionaire businessman and the chairman of the Finnish KONE Corporation, as well as the richest person in Finland – as of January 2025 Forbes reported his net worth as $4.1 billion, naming him the 819th richest person in the world. He is also the former chairman of the Confederation of Finnish Industries.
